usage.source_scope: ①图像 resize/pad 到 1024²；②MegaDepth 预训练 LoFTR 产生 correspondences，保留 confidence>0.8；③Fundamental-matrix RANSAC 过滤几何外点；④分别栅格化“所有 keypoints”与“verified matches”，每图两张 binary mask；⑤用 verified matches 的 partial affine（RANSAC threshold 20）把 image0 及 masks 朝 image1 warp；⑥按固定方向拼接 6 RGB+4 masks 的 10-channel tensor；⑦三层 residual blocks（128/256/512）、average pool、FC；⑧focal loss 学二分类，SfM 时阈值过滤边。关键不是 match 数量，而是“哪里有/没有匹配”的空间布局。

usage.modifications: Only the documented mechanism and evidence boundary were migrated; no implementation, threshold, route authority, or promotion state changed.
usage.expected_effect: 对每个 candidate 独立生成 reference→candidate 与 candidate→reference 两套 match-layout，取保守 min 或经开发集冻结的对称聚合；reference mask 与 candidate mask 限定支持域。用 exact/stable-distractor、遮挡、absent 三类对测试双向差值、低 FPR coverage；集合层仅当最佳候选过绝对阈值且有 margin 才选，否则 NONE。消融 count-only、RGB-only、mask-layout、无 RANSAC。若双向差或低 FPR coverage 不合格即否决。

evaluation.setup: An analytic reciprocal spatial-layout adaptation on 900 source-disjoint Washington RGB-D object pairs; it was not a reproduction of the published Doppelgangers model.
evaluation.effect: Spatial layout produced real rescues and perfect invariance but substantially underperformed the DINO baseline and introduced excessive collateral, closing this passive arm.
evaluation.claim_boundary: This rejects the frozen analytic reciprocal-layout adaptation on this protocol, not the Doppelgangers publication, every learned layout verifier, multi-view evidence, or physical-instance identity in general.
